title: Experiment continuity and observability runbook for progressive rollouts
creator: Ethan Park
description: Create a pragmatic, operator-facing runbook that standardizes continuity guarantees and observability checkpoints for progressive experiment rollouts (A/B, canary, and phased feature flags). This ticket covers metric burn-in windows, signal anchoring, automated guardrails for cost and latency, and a decision lattice for rollforward/rollback. Target audience: SRE, Release Engineers, PMs running experiments, and Experiment Analysts.
acceptance_criteria: Runbook doc exists in Confluence with clear step-by-step operator playbook
Defined continuity matrix mapping critical metrics (latency P95, error rate, model-quality delta, cost per token) to traffic thresholds and actions
Instrumentation checklist and dashboard templates for the Console that can be copied into new experiment boards
Automated alert recipes (PagerDuty, webhook policies) and pre-baked query snippets for anomaly triage
Rollout decision lattice with explicit rollforward guardrails and time-based burn-in requirements
Sign-off from SRE and Research/Applied ML on metric definitions and canary criteria
comments: 2025-11-02 Ethan Park: Initial ticket created after failure post-canary last week; aim to reduce ad-hoc operator judgment by standardizing thresholds and actions.
2025-11-04 Priya Nair (SRE): Suggest adding a KV-cache warmup check and explicit pre-flight validation for model-variant compatibility before canary.
2025-11-06 Miguel Alvarez (Research): For model-quality delta, recommend synthetic prompt set + cohort drift signals rather than relying solely on aggregate embeddings distance.
2025-11-07 Design review (Anika Rao): Dashboard wireframes attached; prefer traffic-tiling visual and a single view with metric health bands to reduce context switching.
2025-11-08 Release Eng (Liam O'Connor): Need API hooks to trigger safe rollback and an endpoint to snapshot current routing rules for fast restore.

2025-11-10 Maya Singh: Draft runbook outline ready in Confluence; next step is to pair with SRE to wire the alert recipes into staging PagerDuty and create Console dashboard templates. Assigned follow-ups to ENG-22018 and ENG-22045.
